Quiver: ctrl_s drops a rung in Act III because Banishing/Grasping are Wisdom/Strength save-DC effects and Combat Extender inflates enemy saves; Arcane Shot Improved's +2d6 does not offset the DC decay.
Act I skl 2 rests on the Fighter/Barbarian Intimidation DC 15 with advantage route to Hag's Hair, not on any Expertise.
Banner: Inspiring Surge's level-18 upgrade to two allies is worth nothing in a duo — scored as one recipient throughout.
Royal Envoy's doubled Persuasion proficiency is Expertise-equivalent but Persuasion opens no gate in the list; skl held at 2.
Riposte: Commander's Strike hands the partner an attack but costs this body its own Action and a die — scored as neutral on rsc, not as a rescue rung.
ctrl_s falls to 2 in Act III on the pure-save-DC decay clause; the manoeuvre DC grows only with proficiency.
Bastion: Act I durability 4 assumes one of the two Act I feats is Heavy Armour Master; rung 5 needs Shield Master and Tough, which the two-feat Act I budget cannot buy.
Heavy Armour Master's mitigation is flat, so Act III's boss-weighted blend is already priced into holding dur at 5 rather than treating it as a rising number.
Bulwark: Warding Maneuver requires the ally within 1.5m; held at rsc 3 rather than the rung-4 prevention clause because a ranged partner is out of range for most of the fight.
Vigilant Defender at 18 adds a reaction on every other creature's turn but only for opportunity attacks — scored inside act 4, not as a fifth rung.
Keen: Champion's Heroic Warrior (10) is a once-per-turn free save reroll — a genuine blanket save effect with no booster id in the closed enum, so it scores as nothing. Worth a human look.
Fighter is assumed the level-1 class for heavy armour and Str+Con saves, so the Blood Hunter dip grants no Int+Dex saves; the split as given is kept.
Fighter 17 never reaches Survivor at 18, so dur stops at 4.
Tempo: Borrowed Time's pool is 1 + Int mod per long rest on a Fighter whose Intelligence is a secondary stat — three to five grants a day. Endurance is held at 4 rather than the Fighter default 5 for that reason.
Rewind (10) is a once-per-short-rest 'ally succeeds the save instead' — scored as the rung-4 prevention clause on rsc from Act II.
Chronoknight is flagged in the class file as added 'for testing' and is the least battle-tested option; every number here is off the DTO documentation site, not the pak.
Echo: Rogue is taken as a later dip so heavy armour and Str+Con saves survive; that means no Expertise and no level-1 Rogue skill package, which is why skl stays at Fighter baseline.
Unleash Incarnation is Con-mod uses per long rest, not at-will — st 4 in Acts II/III assumes it is spent on the hard fights only.
Shadow Martyr (10) is the rsc 4: once per short rest, eat the attack aimed at the partner.
Warmage: act 5 from Act II assumes Haste on the partner off the level-3 slots Eldritch Knight Plus unlocks two levels early at 11; that is what sets concentration true and makes War Caster the natural feat.

Eldritch Knight Plus' level-20 pak is described only as 'full spell progression' at 13–20 — whether that reaches 9th-tier slots is not established from the class file, so aoe is held at 3 in Act III rather than credited with a 9th-tier burst.
Improved War Magic exists in two versions on an EK 18+ (the 12070 passive and Expansion's vanilla one); whether they stack is flagged unverified in the class file and is not scored.
Kinesis: Psionic dice are the shared fuel for st, dur, ctrl_s and rsc simultaneously; the values above assume they are spent mostly on Protective Field, which is the chassis's stated point.
Guarded Mind (10) gives psychic resistance and a die to end charm or fright on yourself — scored as durability, not as a save booster, since it is not in the closed booster list.
Wyrmling: The dragon's stability is explicitly flagged by the mod author (model resets, indoor pathfinding, likely needs a new playthrough). Every action-economy number here assumes it stays alive and on the field.
Gravity Breath is 4/day at 7 and 5/day at 15 — a per-fight burst, so aoe is capped at 2 rather than read as the repeatable rung 3.
Rallying Surge's Retreat option is the only outward effect; rsc 1 is nearly a courtesy.
Sigil: Frost Rune's flat +2 to all Strength and Constitution checks and saves is a real save effect with no booster id; it scores as nothing and is worth a human look.
Master of Runes lands at 15, the last level of Act II, so its doubled uses are credited to Act III rather than Act II.
Rune inscription persistence across rests is flagged partly unverified in the class file; if inscriptions drop on a long rest the durability and control numbers fall a rung.
skl 3 in Act II is Sleight of Hand clearing the Araj pickpocket gate without any Expertise; it falls back in Act III because the Mirror's Religion DC 25 is unreachable.
Resolve: Elegant Courtier grants Wisdom unless you already hold it, so the Lone Wolf picks are taken as Str + Dex here rather than the Str + Wis every other Fighter in this batch uses; that is what makes the Act I save set four disjoint.
Strength Before Death (18) is a free extra turn at 1 HP once per long rest — scored inside dur 5 in Act III, not as rescue.
st 5 is withheld in Act III because Fighting Spirit's advantage is not a per-hit rider, which the rung-5 clause requires.
Bullseye: Steady Aim is three uses per short rest and costs the bonus action, so it competes with Rapid Strike from 15; st 5 in Act III assumes the Sharpshooter feat and Legendary bow attunement on top.
Careful Eyes' Perception proficiency plus Search as a bonus action is the Act II passive-Perception clause, which is why skl holds at 2 there without Expertise.
Hadar: ctrl_a is capped at 3 rather than 4 because Hunger of Hadar and Evard's are both concentration and both pure save-DC; Psionic Sorcery changes what pays for them, not whether they decay.
Summon Beholderkin at Sorcerer 7 is scored as the act jump in Act II; its stat block is not in the read set.
Endurance rises to 3 only at Sorcerer 20 when Expansion's Sorcerous Restoration lands.
Affinity: Sorcerer is taken as the level-1 class so Draconic Resilience's AC 13 applies and the saves are Con + Cha; putting Fighter first would buy heavy armour but lose the bloodline's armour fix and both save grants. Split kept as given.

act 4–5 assumes Twinned Haste covers both bodies, which is what sets concentration true; the Magic Missile plan itself needs no concentration, so a variant that drops Haste scores act 3 and concentration false.
Sorcerer 18 never reaches Sorcerous Restoration, so Endurance stops at 2.
Chosen: Scored on the Life or Peace domain, which is what the class file names as the default; a Light or Tempest pick trades the rescue block for aoe.

act falls from 5 to 4 across the acts because the rung-5 configuration is act-relative — Twinned Haste is the Act I ceiling, but Act II and III ceilings add Improved Extra Attack and 9th-tier summon sets this chassis has no route to.
rsc 5 in Acts II–III has no no-action outward healing (no Twilight Sanctuary equivalent); it is earned by Twinning turning every prevention and restoration cast into full party coverage.
Anointed: Level order assumed as Sorcerer 1–6 then Paladin 1–6, so Divine Smite arrives around character 8 and Aura of Protection around character 12 — Act I therefore has neither. A front-loaded Paladin block would move both into Act I and flatten the act movement.
Sorcerer must be the level-1 class for the Favored Soul domain, which means the Paladin node grants no heavy armour and no Wisdom/Charisma save proficiencies.
aura-of-protection is a pair effect; a partner also carrying Paladin 6 wastes it.
Umbral: Hound of Ill Omen lands at Sorcerer 6, so only the back half of Act I holds it — ctrl_s 3 rather than 4 in Act I for that reason.

The class file flags a redundancy: Expansion also ships Umbral Form at 18 for Shadow Magic, and whether the two implementations stack, conflict or overwrite is unverified. The Act III durability 4 rests entirely on Umbral Form working.
True Darkness is not installed, so the published Shadow Sorcerer darkness-cheese builds do not apply and ctrl_a is scored on plain Darkness plus the Sorcerer list.
Gale: Cleric is taken as the level-1 class for Tempest's heavy armour, martial weapons and the Wis + Cha saves; Storm Sorcery's own level-1 features arrive with Sorcerer 1 whenever it is taken, so nothing is lost by that ordering.

Lightning/Thunder is a commonly-resisted pair under Absolute Wrath and this chassis carries no resistance strip, no Elemental Adept and no second damage type — st is capped at 3 for that reason, well under the rubric's Act II cap of 4.
The 16/2/2 split yields six feats where a 20 or a 17/3 yields seven; that is priced into every 4 above.
Luck: Bend Luck arrives at Sorcerer 6, i.e. around character 8 with the Fighter 3 block in front of it; Act I holds it for one or two levels only.

rsc 3–4 is Bend Luck read as prevention aimed at the partner's failing save. It is not healing and not restoration, so it can never reach 5 — but it is repeatable off a reaction the body otherwise wastes.

Wild Magic Surge is scored as neutral. A surge that Banishes, Confuses or polymorphs this body removes half the party, and no axis in the model prices that; a human should decide whether the chassis belongs in the ledger at all.
Dread: ctrl_a drops from 4 to 3 in Act III on the save-DC decay clause; the aura damage is unaffected but it is entirely conditional on the Frighten landing.
The mod author states the speed-reduction half of Aura of Conquest does nothing in BG3 and no installed mod reimplements it — only the psychic damage is scored.
aura-of-protection is a pair effect; a second Paladin 6 in the pairing wastes it.
Devout: Aura of Devotion's charm immunity is scored on rsc as prevention aimed at the partner, on the same reading that puts Death Ward and Sanctuary at rung 4. It is not scored again on this body's own durability.
Sacred Weapon adds Charisma to attack rolls rather than damage, so it does not qualify as a per-hit rider for the st rung-5 clause.
Enmity: Endurance is held at 3, not raised, despite the short-rest pact slots — the rubric's Endurance section explicitly prices Paladin 13 / Warlock 7 at ~18 units against Paladin 17 / Warlock 3's ~21. The dip buys tempo, not clock.
Level order assumed Paladin through 11 first, then the Warlock block; that puts Aura of Protection in Act I and third-level pact slots in Act II.
Paladin 14 never reaches the level-15 oath feature or the capstone, so Acts II and III are nearly flat.
Warding: Aura of Warding is one feature covering two bodies, so it is scored once on dur (this body's own spell-damage resistance) and once on rsc (the partner's). That is the same shape as Aura of Protection, which the schema handles as a pair booster — Aura of Warding has no booster id, so the rsc entry is the only place the partner half is visible. Worth a human check that this is not being double-counted.
Nature's Wrath is a short-rest Channel Oath restrain on a Strength or Dexterity save, so ctrl_s stays at 2 rather than rising with the acts.
Bleak: skl 3 in Act I is Expertise ×1 plus Charisma 22 clearing the single named Act I skill gate; the ladder's rung 3 nominally wants Expertise ×2 and Guidance, so this is scored on the gate clause rather than the proficiency clause.
Paladin 15 never reaches the level-17 oath spells or the capstone, so Act III movement comes almost entirely from the Sorcerer block.
Death's Maw's proficiency-bonus damage reduction requires standing within 2m of a corpse; dur 3 in Act I does not assume it is up.
Regent: Divine Allegiance and Warding Bond are both damage redirection and are held to the rubric's rung-1 cap; the rsc 4 in Acts II–III is Aura of Vitality and Lay on Hands, not the redirection.

Champion Challenge and Compelled Duel are Wisdom-save taunts, so they should decay with enemy saves — they are held flat at 3 because a taunt that fails still costs only a Channel Oath charge, unlike a lost concentration spell.
Royal Decree, the mod.io cantrip Listo adds to this oath, has unverified mechanics and is not scored.
Lunar: Paladin holds one Channel Oath charge restoring on a short rest, so Full Moon, Divine Guardian and Punish the Wicked are mutually exclusive per rest. The ctrl_a and rsc numbers cannot both be delivered in the same fight.

Lunar Champion at 20 gives every non-enemy within 18m a Charisma-mod bonus to all saving throws plus an extra Reaction — a blanket save effect with no booster id in the closed enum, so it scores as nothing. Worth a human look.
Listo's global aura patch is noted as unverified for a v10.0-era subclass, so Aura of Moonlight may be 3m rather than 9m; at 3m the partner half of the rsc score does not apply to a ranged partner.
Aura of Moonlight is scored on rsc (partner) and Divine Guardian's self-use on dur, to avoid scoring one feature twice.
Spite: st is held at 3 in Act II rather than the usual Paladin 4 because Act 2's enemies are precisely the ones that resist necrotic, and this chassis carries no second damage type and no resistance strip.

act rises in Acts II–III on Animate Dead at Paladin 9 read against the rubric's Animate Dead++ note (cap removed, Undead Thralls extended); the undead count itself is not established from the class file.

Aura of Hate becomes a genuine duo aura only if the partner is a Ghastly Ghouls playable undead — and the same races file warns the undead tag breaks most healing, including Lay on Hands. Scored assuming a normal partner.
Squall: Storm's Reach's damage table is locked at the level-12 value and does not scale past it, so it is a falling contribution across Acts II and III and is not credited above rung 3.

act 4 in every act is the Conjure Animals set the Act I ceiling row names — non-concentration until long rest via 13458, with Automated Summons running their turns. Every Druid in this batch gets it, so it does not differentiate.
Ember: Cauterizing Flames and Blazing Revival are at unverified levels in this pack (5e puts them at 6 and 14); the Act III durability 4 assumes Blazing Revival is online by then.
The circle's damage is Fire throughout and it carries no resistance strip, which is why aoe is held at 3 rather than rising.
Blazing Revival requires the Wildfire Spirit to activate it on its own turn, not instantly — so it is not the clean 'do not go down' that Strength of the Grave or Rite Revival is.
Rime: The Prone rider at 10 is scored on the rung-4 'costs no concentration' clause even though it is still a save; the clause is a disjunction, so the save-DC decay does not pull it back down in Act III.
Winter Spirit's bonus Cold damage explicitly does not count as a Cold Druid spell for the Prone rider, so the two features do not compound.
Cold is a commonly-resisted type under Absolute Wrath and this circle has no resistance strip and no second damage type, which caps aoe at 3.
Aspect: The class file's source is the author's documentation site, which stops at level 14 — 15–20 is explicitly unverified, so Act III is scored as Act II plus the ordinary full-caster 9th-tier progression and nothing subclass-specific.
Circle of Wrath ships in the same 'added for testing' DTO pak as Chronoknight; treat both as the least battle-tested entries in this batch.

concentration is false because the aspect cantrips and revelations need none — the value of that in a pair is a full rung on control per the model, and it is not visible in this chassis's own numbers.
Wellspring: Circle spells vary by land type and are not enumerated in the class file; the control and area numbers are scored on the base Druid list only.

Endurance 4 in Acts II–III is Natural Recovery's growing charges (2/3/5/7) spent across two short rests per cycle; the rubric's rung 4 anchor is Monk 14, and this is a slot refund rather than a healing pool, so it does not reach 5.
Wildform: concentration is false because the plan spends its turns in beast form, where the Druid's concentration control cannot be cast. A Wildform that stays out of Wild Shape to hold Sleet Storm is a different chassis and should be scored as one.
Druid is taken as the level-1 class for Int + Wis; Fighter 3 as a later dip therefore grants no heavy armour and no Str/Con saves, which is fine since Wild Shape uses the beast's AC.
The level 10 second Extra Attack is removed under the Wild Shape Overhaul, so st does not move after Act I.
Tide: act 5 from Act II is Oceanic Gift at level 14, which hands the partner a repeatable bonus-action damage-and-push. It is not literally an Action handed over, but it is the closest thing in this batch and the rung-5 clause is the right shelf for it.

Crashing Wave requires the target to be inside a 2m (4m from level 6) current centred on this body, which is a real positioning tax on a chassis otherwise scored as ranged-capable — hence reach hybrid.
The push is single-target, so it is not credited on ctrl_a.
Pack: Mighty Summoner's level is unverified in this pack (5e puts it at 6), and Guardian Spirit and Faithful Summons are not named on the mod page at all — so Acts II and III are scored on the totems and the base summon set only.
The Bear totem's temp HP is scored on rsc as the rung-4 no-action outward clause and is not also credited on this body's own durability.
A summon's action is worth less than a character's; the whole set is scored as one rung of surplus plus soak, per the Actions rubric, not as N actions.
Symbiote: Cleric is assumed the level-1 class (a heavy-armour domain) for heavy armour plus Wis + Cha saves, which costs the Druid's Int + Wis. If Druid is put first instead, dur falls a rung and the save set changes to int/wis/con/dex.
That the Spore Extra Attack mod and the Wild Shape Overhaul resolve to exactly one Extra Attack is flagged unverified in the class file; st collapses a rung if it does not.
act 5 counts Fungal Infestation's four zombies per long rest alongside Conjure Animals and the familiar. Zombies come from corpses, so the first fight of a day has none.
Omen: Cosmic Omen is scored on rsc as short-rest prevention aimed at the partner's saves. Woe on an enemy's save is control and Weal on the partner's is rescue; the charges are the same pool, so the two cannot both be delivered.
Guidance from level 2 lifts skl to 2 without any Expertise; the ladder's rung 3 wants Expertise ×2 as well, which no Druid chassis in this batch has.

Dragon form's concentration floor (treat rolls of 9 or lower as 10) is a genuine concentration protection with no booster id — war-caster covers advantage on concentration saves, which is a different mechanism, so it is left unscored.
Dawnrite: Dark Augmentation at 10 adds max(1, Int mod) to Strength, Dexterity and Constitution saves — a large permanent save bonus with no booster id in the closed enum, so it scores as nothing. It covers three saves rather than all six, so it is not simply brutish-durability, but a human should decide whether the enum needs a fourth member.
Blood Hunter's level-1 Int + Dex collides with the obvious Lone Wolf picks; the save sets above assume Lone Wolf goes on Dex + Con and a Resilient (Wisdom) feat lands by Act II.
The three skills come from a list with no Deception, Intimidation, Sleight of Hand or Religion route that clears a gate, which is why skl is 1 in all three acts.
Hybrid: Bloodlust is a structural liability between levels 3 and 14 that no axis in the model prices: a failed Wisdom save makes this body attack the nearest creature, which in a duo is the partner. It is scored as neutral, and a human should decide whether that is acceptable. Resilient (Wisdom) is close to mandatory here rather than optional.
Dark Augmentation at 10 (Int mod to Str/Dex/Con saves) has no booster id and scores as nothing.

Predatory Strikes want no heavy armour, so the Resilient Hide +1 AC clause applies; dur 4 is medium armour, a shield, non-magical physical resistance and Lycan Regeneration together, not heavy armour.
Mutagen: The st ladder above assumes Cruelty is running. Cruelty imposes disadvantage on Int, Wis and Cha saves for as long as it is active, which the derived saves value cannot express — the authored prof set will read as rung 4 while the body is actually taking every Hold, Fear and Dominate at disadvantage. This is the most severe mismatch in the batch and needs a human decision.

The resistance mutagens each grant a matching vulnerability, a much larger liability in a two-body party than a four-body one; dur is held at 3–4 for that reason rather than credited with the resistances.
Dark Augmentation at 10 has no booster id and scores as nothing.
Scarbrand: ctrl_s 5 in Acts II–III is Brand of the Sapping Scar (the rubric's own named Act II anchor) plus Hold Person cast off short-rest pact slots. The rubric's rung-5 row pairs the Brand with Chains of Carceri, which needs Warlock 12 and is not available on this chassis — pact slots standing in for it is the judgement call.
Scored with a control-shaped patron (Hexblade or Great Old One). A Celestial patron trades Blood Maledicts for healing and would lift rsc to 3 at the cost of the Brand's supporting damage.
Eldritch Blast is available but Profane Soul gets no Eldritch Invocations, so there is no Agonizing Blast and no Charisma on the beams — and beams are 1d8 here, not 1d10.
Dark Augmentation at 10 has no booster id and scores as nothing.
Abjurer: Arcane Abjuration's banish keys off target level (CR ½ / 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 at Cleric 5/8/11/14/17) and only touches celestial/elemental/fey/fiend — scored as trash removal, not a boss answer.
Arcane Mastery (L17) needs 5e Spells for its 6th–9th wizard picks; the exact list is not stated.
Thrall: Control Undead needs an undead enemy present; scored one rung under a summon set to price that conditionality.
Control Undead and Turn Undead share the Channel Divinity pool, so the third body and the crowd answer compete.
Torpor: Dream is DTO, added 'for testing'; the domain's armour and weapon proficiencies are not stated on the mod page.
Inception consumes a Channel Divinity charge per cast, so the non-decaying disadvantage is 1/2/3 casts per short rest by act — that is what holds Act I to 3.
Prophecy: Prophecy of Doom is a pure Wis-save effect and should decay as enemy DCs climb; Act III is held at 4 only because L17 adds 10d10 psychic to the same charge.
Anvil: Heavy Armour Master's mitigation is flat and therefore crowd-facing; against boss-weighted Act III encounters the raw 5 flatters it.
The domain's Sleight of Hand proficiency is the only route this body has to the Act II Araj and Act III music-box gates, and Dex is a dump stat here.
Sentinel: Sentinel at Death's Door is Wis-modifier uses per long rest, so it is a per-day budget rather than a per-fight one.
Witchhunter: The author states Witch Hunter's Strike does not stack with the Divine Strike interrupt from L8 — both riders on one swing needs a manual Divine Strike action, which the single-target score assumes is used.
Lorekeeper: CCC's Magical Secrets at Cleric 6 and 10 is the load-bearing feature for the actions and control scores and its pick count and list are unverified on the CCC page.
Assumes Cleric is the level-1 class (Wis + Cha saves) with the Bard 3 block taken at characters 2–4.
Vitalist: Goon's fix makes Blessed Healer heal only the caster, so it is scored as Durability rather than Rescue.
Flare: Improved Warding Flare only protects allies from Cleric 6 (character 6), so Act I is scored on the last third of the band.
Thornclad: Listo makes Shillelagh a level-1 spell rather than a cantrip, so it must be recast from a slot; whether the domain's L1 cantrip picker still offers it is not confirmed.
Master of Nature (L17) only commands charmed creatures, so the third body it buys is conditional on Charm Animals and Plants landing.
Nightward: Invocation of Night is a pure Con-save effect, so it loses a rung between Act II and Act III as enemy DCs climb — the L17 aura and the third charge do not fully offset that.
Blind fails outright against enemies that cannot be Blinded, which the mod text flags but does not enumerate.
Authority: Voice of Authority's reaction attack picks a random enemy in the ally's weapon range, so it is a free attack but not a directed one.
Embodiment of the Law is Wis-modifier uses per long rest, a per-day budget rather than a per-fight one.
Bond: Emboldening Bond's permanent d4 to every saving throw on both bodies is a blanket save booster, but there is no id for it in the closed booster list — it is therefore contributing nothing to the derived saves value and this chassis is scored a rung low on saves.
Titan: Haste is this body's one concentration spell, so hasting the partner and holding any control spell are mutually exclusive.
Whether the L1 druid cantrip pick can still take Shillelagh is unverified now that Listo has made it a level-1 spell.
Stormvest: Assumes Cleric (Tempest) is the level-1 class for Wis + Cha saves and heavy armour, with Sorcerer 1–3 taken immediately after; taking Sorcerer first would swap Wis for a second Con grant and lose a save.
Multiclass Preferred Casting Ability Fix is relied on to keep Charisma as the spellcasting stat through the Cleric dip.
Stormcall: Thunder and lightning are both commonly resisted under Absolute Wrath and the chassis carries no strip, so single-target is capped from Act II regardless of Divine Strike scaling.
Duplicity: Poison is among the most resisted types under Absolute Wrath and Trickery carries no strip, so Divine Strike contributes almost nothing from Act II.
Sanctuary: Twilight Sanctuary's temp HP is counted once, on Durability for the self-facing half and Rescue for the partner-facing half; the mod implements the end-of-turn effects as interrupts, which the author warns is UI-noisy.
Warpriest: Assumes Cleric is the level-1 class (Wis + Cha) with the Fighter 3 block at characters 7–9; starting Fighter would trade Cha for Str and add heavy armour the domain already grants.
Extra Attack lands at character 6, so Act I is scored on the last third of the band.
Pyre: Assumes Cleric 1–2 then Fighter 1–5 (Extra Attack at character 7) then Cleric 3–15; deferring the Fighter block instead would push Extra Attack into Act II and drop Act I single-target by two rungs.
Priest of Zeal's charges are Wis-modifier per long rest, so the bonus-action swing is a per-day budget while the Extra Attack is not.
Legerdemain: Magical Ambush (Rogue 9) requires Hiding to impose disadvantage on saves, which is a real per-turn cost the control-single 4 does not price.
Slippery Mind at Rogue 15 adds Wisdom, which Lone Wolf already supplies here, so the back half of the class buys nothing on saves.
Alacrity: Assumes Rogue is the level-1 class for Dex + Int, four skills and Expertise ×2, with Ranger 1–3 at characters 4–6; Ranger first would give Str + Dex instead and lose the Expertise.
Death Strike at Rogue 17 lands at character 20, so the Act III lift is one level deep.
Sightline: Unerring Eye's uses are Wisdom-modifier per long rest, which a Dex/Con Rogue will not have.
Act III drops a rung on skills because the Mirror of Loss is Religion DC 25 and no Rogue package covers an Intelligence knowledge skill.
Tactician: Assumes Rogue is the level-1 class with Bard 3 taken later, so the Bard block grants one skill rather than three and no saving throws.
Insightful Manipulator's save penalty scales with Wisdom modifier, which is a poor fit for a Dex build.
Wail: Tokens of the Departed grants advantage on Constitution saves while a Soul Trinket is held; there is no booster id for a conditional advantage source, so the derived saves value is a rung low whenever a trinket is up.
The Cunning Strike compatibility patch was authored against Book of Rogues 1.0.0.2 and its author did not test the level-17 features, which is exactly where Death's Friend sits.
Skirmish: Ambush Master's advantage mark is a tempo buff for the pair rather than anything aimed at keeping the partner up, so it scores nothing on Rescue.
Parry: The Sorcery Point pool is 1 + Int modifier on a long rest and refills only when enemies cast spells, so Auspicious Parry's uptime is highly encounter-dependent — the durability scores assume a caster-bearing fight.
Seeker is DTO, entered the list 'for testing', and its features are documented only on the author's site.
Psiblade: The number and size of Psionic Energy Dice and their recovery rate are not stated anywhere in the source, and they fund the accuracy fix, the mobility, the invisibility and Rend Mind — every score here that depends on them is a guess.
Psychic damage is commonly resisted under Absolute Wrath and Psychic Blades carry no strip, so single-target is capped from Act II.
Rakish: Assumes Rogue 1–3, Paladin 1–8 at characters 4–11 (Extra Attack at 8, Aura of Protection at 9), then Rogue 4–12; deferring Paladin would push the aura into Act III.
Paladin taken as a later class grants medium armour and shields only, not heavy — the durability scores reflect that.
The Swashbuckler Rakish Sneak Attack RAW rework is 2.x only and therefore absent from the installed 1.2.2.0 bugfix.
Fasthands: Thief's Reflexes is rated 90–95% working by its own author and explicitly breaks in combats you cannot escape and with shared turns between allies; the Act III actions 5 assumes it fires.
Fast Hands does not stack with the Thief's Apprentice feat, so that feat is off the table here.
Pirouette: Genuinely three-stat: Dexterity for the unarmed attack, Charisma for spell DC and the Inspiration engine, Wisdom for Unarmoured Defence. The primary listed is Dexterity because that is what the attack rolls use.
Tandem Footwork and Leading Evasion are described only in images on the mod page and are not scored.
Assumes Bard is the level-1 class; Monk 1 first would trade Charisma for Strength on the save set.
Silver: The mod's own Known Issues list says Silver Tongue is not working properly; the skills scores do not depend on it, but they would rise a rung if it does work.
Unfailing Inspiration falls back to a flat 50% refund on ability checks because the author could not detect success or failure.
Mantle: Unbreakable Majesty is a Charisma save against your spell DC and therefore decays as enemy saves scale, which the Act III durability 3 does not discount.
Peerless: The Act III skills 5 assumes Peerless Skill's die plus Expertise plus inspiration rerolls clears the Mirror of Loss at Religion DC 25 on a Charisma body with no Intelligence behind it; that is the marginal call in this batch.
Cutting Words is blocked by Silence, by Deafened targets and by Charm immunity after Goon's fix.
Aria: Whether Electrifying Aria requires concentration is not stated; Conductor definitely does, and if the Aria does too the pair can hold only one of them and the area-control scores fall a rung.
Stormcalling is DTO, entered the list 'for testing', and is documented only on the author's site.
Electrifying Aria is a 7th-level slot, so it is roughly one cast per fight rather than the short-rest clock rung 5 describes.
Flourish: Do not plan this around Arcane Acuity — the source file flags it explicitly and none of these scores assume it.
Two-stat: Dexterity for the weapon, Charisma for the Inspiration die and spell DC.
Pathos: Sorrowful Fate is not an interrupt — it must be pre-cast on the target before the save is forced, with a one-turn grace period, which makes the control-single scores optimistic against unscripted fights.
Nimbus of Pathos is scored as near-worthless for Rescue because its end condition drops the recipient to 0 HP; it would be the best buff in the batch on a third body the pair does not have.
The subclass feature names are matched from the Tal'Dorei source; only Nimbus of Pathos was recoverable from the mod page text.
Anthem: Assumes Bard is the level-1 class with the Fighter 2 block at characters 7–8; starting Fighter would buy heavy armour and Str + Con saves but cost the Charisma save and two skills.
Fighter 2 breaks no feat block here, but it is two levels that buy only Action Surge and Second Wind.
Rally: The Paragon page's own text says a Paragon gets six feats, which contradicts the 3/6/9/12/13/15/18 cadence arithmetic; seven is used here per the scoring brief.
The level-20 capstone Paragon Of Legend (+4 to two stats, cap 25) is why Charisma is listed at 24 rather than 22, and it is reachable only by pure Paragon 20.
Banner Charges stay on the long-rest clock until Paragon 6, which is what holds Act I to 3 on actions.
Cinder: Searing Blade's strip is a Constitution save, so the whole debuff package decays as enemy DCs climb; the resistance-strip's value to the partner is a pair effect this row cannot express.
The Paragon page's own text says six feats rather than the seven the cadence implies; seven is used per the brief.
Ironwill: Whether the Tharchiate blessing's DamageReduction(All,Half) composes multiplicatively with Lone Wolf's own halving is unconfirmed from data; none of these scores assume 75% total reduction.
Sheer Will's flat reduction and Heavy Armour Master's are both flat and therefore crowd-facing; against boss-weighted Act III encounters the 5 flatters this body.
Echo of the Soul's ally-count scaling is nearly dead in a duo — +1d10, not +5d10.
Oberon: Fairy's Curse is a Charisma save against your spell DC and so decays across the run; the crit-threshold reduction is what keeps it repeatable enough to hold rung 4.
Whether Strike Of The Butterflies' −3 crit threshold stacks with the Critfisher Ring and Ring of Viciousness is unverified, and the equipment file flags the same question.
Oberon's Favor's rider is Psychic, which Absolute Wrath resists, though the base weapon damage is not.
Armament: Magic Resistance (Paragon 9) grants advantage on saves against spells and magical effects — a blanket save booster with no id in the closed list, so the derived saves value here is a rung low from Act II.
Whether the Potent Robe fires on Spell Sword attacks, which are 'considered cantrips', is unverified; if it does the single-target scores are conservative.
The Act I aoe 2 assumes one of the two starting Focuses is Force or Thunder, which are the only ones that hit enemies around the target.
Pactblade: The seed's premise fails: Will Over Weave is Paragon 13 and this chassis takes only Paragon 3, so it never gets slot-free Counterspell. Scores reflect what Paragon 3 actually delivers — Fighting Style, Actions Speak Louder, Scholar's Armament, two Focuses, shields and martial weapons.
Assumes Warlock is the level-1 class for Wis + Cha, with the Paragon block at characters 7–9; Paragon 3 taken later grants no heavy armour, no saves and no skills.
Chains of Carceri is dated to Warlock 12 per the rubric, but the warlock file places the Expansion invocations at 15 and 18 — the Act III control-single 4 is stable either way, Act II's 3 is not.
Nirvana: Wisdom of Void wants 6 Willpower Dice, exactly the level-17 pool, so it is realistically once per short rest and only pairs with Beyond All Limits at 18 for a single enormous round.
Falling Rain substitutes 1d4 for the weapon's damage dice, so the free attacks are cheap rather than large — the actions scores carry more of its value than the single-target ones.
Glamour: Fey Presence is a pure save-DC effect and loses a rung between Act II and Act III as enemy DCs climb; Archfey has no level-14 feature to offset it.
The seed claims Beguiling Defences protects both bodies; the source describes it only as a level-10 patron feature with no partner clause, so Rescue is scored 0.
Chains of Carceri is dated Warlock 12 per the rubric but Warlock 15/18 per the class file's Expansion invocation list.
Radiance: Death Ward is not on the Celestial expanded list, so this body never reaches the prevention clause that rung 5 on Rescue requires.
Radiant Soul adds Charisma to one radiant or fire damage roll per spell, implemented as a once-per-spell interrupt — it does not apply per Eldritch Blast beam.
Infernal: Eldritch Cone reads LevelMapValue(EldritchZoneDamage), which ends at 3d10 from character 10, and its SpellSuccess never checks AgonizingBlast — the Act III drop from 4 to 3 on aoe is that, not a level-order artefact.
Hurl Through Hell (Expansion, level 14) is scored as the Act II control-single lift; it is once per long rest.
Dark One's Blessing keeps temporary HP up on kills, which is the Tharchiate Codex condition — a pair-level interaction this row cannot express.
Whisper: Mortal Reminder's fire rate depends entirely on crit frequency across four to eight beams a round; no crit-threshold source is assumed here, so the control-single 4 is the optimistic end of a wide band.
Eldritch Cone stops scaling at character 10, which is the Act III aoe drop.
Blackblade: Assumes Warlock 1–3, Paladin 1–8 at characters 4–11 (Extra Attack at 8, Aura of Protection at 9), then Warlock 4–12.
Six feats, not seven: Warlock 12 pays at class levels 3/6/9/12 and Paladin 8 at 3/6, so this split loses a feat to the 20-level cap.
Smiting off short-rest pact slots is the Endurance claim; it assumes the pact slots are spent on smites rather than on levelled casts.
Accursed: Sorcery points scale off Sorcerer class level only — 3 points at a 3-level dip — so Quickened Spell at 3 points is one cast per long rest. The single-target scores are held to 4 for that reason, not 5.
Twinned Death Ward is unreachable: Death Ward is a Sorcerer 7 spell and is not on the Hexblade list, so Rescue never gets past redirection.
Eldritch Cone stops scaling at character 10, which is the Act III aoe drop.
Warp: Whether Warp detonations count as Eldritch Blast for Agonizing Blast or for Mizora's IsEldritchBlastAlike() rider system is unverified; if they do not, single-target is a rung lower throughout.
The max-HP drain is scored twice as a cost — once on Durability, once on Endurance — because it both softens the body and forces the 120-supply long rest. That is a judgement, not a rubric clause.
Psyker is DTO, added 'for testing', and Chaos Rift's status table is random.
Frenzy: Fighter 3 subclass is unspecified; scored as Battle Master, which is the only version that adds anything to control.
Wildsurge: Goon's Magic Awareness adds proficiency bonus to BOTH characters' saves against spells. That is a pair-wide blanket save booster with no id in the closed list, so it scores as nothing.
Totem: Goon's bug fixes for Crocodile / Honey Badger / Stallion / Tiger / Wolverine are in v1.2.0.0, which Listo did not pull; only Bear and Eagle are scored as working.
Null: Null Warrior's Advantage on all saving throws against spells and magical effects while raging is a blanket save booster with no id in the closed list, so it scores as nothing. This is the largest under-count in this batch.
Claw: An extra Action from Haste starts a new Attack action and forfeits the bonus claw attack, so this chassis is a poor Haste target.
Galvanic: Listo ships CD's nerf patch on top of this mod; it is not a Nexus archive and is not in the manifest, so every published number is lower by an unknown amount. All damage-bearing values here are provisional.
Wraith: "Cannot be healed by any means" makes this body inert against any partner whose rescue is healing; that is a pairing constraint the model has no field for.
Immunity to Charm, Fear, Poison and Disease is condition immunity rather than a save bonus, so it is not authorable as a booster.
Fury: Fanatical Focus rerolls one failed saving throw every Rage — not per rest — which is a blanket save booster with no id in the closed list.
Barbarian is scored as the level-1 class for Str+Con saves and the d12; taking Paladin 1 instead would swap the pair to Wis+Cha and add heavy armour.
Aegis: Spell Resistance at Wizard 14 grants resistance to spell damage AND advantage on all saving throws against spells and cantrips — a blanket save booster with no id in the closed list, so Act III saves reads a rung low.
Split does not fix class order; scored Wizard-first, which keeps Int+Wis but forfeits the heavy armour a Fighter 1 opener would supply.
Bladesong: Bladesong's +2 to +4 applies only to Constitution saves, so it is not a blanket booster and is not authorable; the concentration protection it buys is real but invisible to the saves axis.
Menagerie: The mod places Minor Conjuration at 3 and vanilla places it at 2; whether the level-2 slot is replaced or supplemented is unverified.
Portent: Expansion's changelog adds Greater Portent at 14; the class file lists it as unverified, so Act III does not score it.
Charm: Sorcery points scale on Sorcerer class level only, so a 3-dip holds 3 points; Twinned Death Ward at 4 points is only reachable by converting a slot through Font of Magic, which limits it to roughly one cast a fight.
Pactbook: Agonizing Blast adds Charisma, a dump stat here, so the invocations are scored as defensive picks (Armour of Shadows, Fiendish Vigour, Devil's Sight) rather than as a damage line.
Level-10 immunity to all emotion-altering conditions is not a save bonus and has no booster id.
Legion: Necromancy Heals Undead lets Inflict Wounds and Harm top the bodies up mid-fight, but it aims at the undead, not the partner, so nothing lands on Rescue.
Formula: Levels for Wizardly Quill and Awakened Spellbook and the exact Formulaic Attunement bonus are unverified — the mod page tables are images.
Stone: Transmuter's Stone granting Constitution save proficiency to the OTHER body changes that body's prof set. The schema has no way to author a proficiency handed across the pair, so the effect is scored as Rescue rung 2 on this body and does not raise the partner's saves at all.
Deflection: The per-level feature table for Arcane Deflection, Tactical Wit, Power Surge and Durable Magic is images-only on the mod page. Every value on this chassis is provisional until read off the level-up screen.
Arcane Deflection is described as an AC and save spike; if it is a blanket save bonus it would deserve a booster, and there is no id for it.
Valkyrie: The author swapped Zeal and Valkyrie in 1.2.0.66, so the level-3 pick is Valkyrie and Zeal lands at 7; scored on that ordering.
Drake: The mod author warns you may need to start a new playthrough when taking this subclass or the drake animates incorrectly.
Parley: Rungs 3 and 4 of the Skills ladder both name Guidance, which neither Bard nor Ranger can cast. Scored on gates cleared rather than on Guidance, so the value is one interpretation of an ambiguous ladder.
Misty Wanderer only resolves reliably in turn-based mode, per the mod author.
Ambush: Iron Mind's Wisdom and Intelligence grants duplicate proficiencies this build already holds, so six levels of Ranger buy nothing on the saves axis; a Ranger-first order would have made them count.
Shadowy Dodge resolves after you know the roll, an engine limitation, so it is scored as durability rather than as control.
Planar: Ethereal Step must be used in turn-based mode or it is wasted; scored as a durability rung, not as an action.
Volley: Act III drops a rung on AoE because Volley does not scale — it is already full weapon damage — while the act's rung-5 configuration adds a 9th-tier burst a half-caster cannot reach.
Quarry: Supernatural Defense (+1d6 on every save forced by your prey) and Slayer's Counter (auto-succeed) are conditional rather than blanket, so neither is authorable as a booster and the saves axis reads a rung low against the boss this chassis is built for.
Warden: Piercing Thorns works in turn-based mode only, and the guardian form is VFX-based and misbehaves with model-replacing effects.
Guardian Aura lands at 15, the last level of Act II, so the Act II value is an average across a band the feature is absent from for most of.
Frostglare: Ranger is scored as the level-1 class, which keeps Lone Wolf's +4 on Wisdom and therefore a real Glaring Frost save DC. Taking Paladin 1 instead would buy heavy armour and Wis+Cha saves but leave the whole control line running off a point-bought stat.
Paladin 3 is only two Channel Oath charges and 1st-level slots; the smites that trigger Glaring Frost come from a small long-rest pool.
Swarm: Whether the Moths' Blind is applied flat or on a save is not stated in the class file; scored as costing no concentration and no resource, which is the rung-4 clause, but if it carries a save it decays and Act III should read 3.
Zephyr: The mod page defers Elemental Burst, Stride of the Elements and Elemental Epitome numbers to in-game screenshots, so every value from Monk 6 onward is provisional.
Control-single drops in Act III because Stunning Strike and the elemental riders are pure save-DC control and bosses gain +1 spell save DC per 7 levels.
Mercy: Cleric 1 is scored as the level-1 class for Wis+Cha; Diamond Soul therefore lands at character 17 and the all-six coverage is Act III only. A Monk-first order moves it into Act II instead.
Implements of Mercy's two skill picks come from an unenumerated list in the pak, so the Skills value assumes ordinary picks rather than gate-clearing ones.
Umbra: Skills falls a rung in Act III: Expertise on Sleight of Hand clears the Circus pickpocket gate but nothing here clears Religion DC 25 at the Mirror of Loss, and Rogue 3 does not reach Reliable Talent.
Way of Shadow Revised is not in Listo — only its katana add-on — so this is the vanilla subclass.
Breath: Ascendant Aspect's Blindsight requires Tasha's Fighting Styles RAW, which is not in the 10.2 TSV, so it is treated as non-functional.
Draconic Presence grants advantage on a Charisma check once per long rest, which is a real Hag's Hair enabler on a dump stat; it is not enough to move the Skills rung.
Astral: Requires Script Extender for the Wisdom-based attack conversion; if that fails the whole chassis reverts to a Dex Monk and every single-target value here is wrong.
Kinship: war-caster is authored for Guardian of Light, which grants advantage on Concentration checks while a shield is equipped — the same effect the booster describes, from a class feature rather than the feat. If the renderer's registry keys the id to the feat specifically, this is over-claimed.
Friar's Blessing's +1d4 to all saving throws on both bonded characters is a pair-wide blanket save bonus with no id in the closed list, so it scores as nothing.
Edge: Sharpen the Blade has no effect on a weapon that already carries an enchantment bonus, which in Listo's gear-dense list means the level-11 feature is usually dead; the Act II and III single-target values do not count it.
Monk is scored as the level-1 class, so Diamond Soul lands at character 17 and the all-six coverage is Act III only.
Fighter 3 subclass unspecified; scored as Battle Master.
Undying: Touch of the Long Death is necrotic, the most commonly resisted type in this list, with no strip attached, so Act III single-target is held to 4.
Mastery of Death is self-only and therefore scores as Durability, not Rescue — the partner still goes down normally.
Topple: This is pure save-DC control, so it loses a rung between Act II and Act III as boss spell save DCs climb — the movement is deliberate, not an error.
Sunbolt: Radiant is the only damage type on the bolt line, which caps single-target at 4 from Act II under Absolute Wrath; Searing Arc Strike's fire is the only second type and it costs ki.
Stunning Strike needs a melee unarmed or monk-weapon hit, so a body committed to Sun Bolt gives up the class's whole control axis. Scored that way.
Panache: Towering Ego at Mesmerist 2 gives +Charisma to Wisdom saves and +half Charisma to Intelligence saves permanently — roughly +5 on the highest-value save in the run — and there is no booster id for it, so every Mesmerist reads at least a rung low on saves.
Max spell level is unverified; the mod page never states a cap and the class file infers 5th.
Stare: Towering Ego's +Charisma to Wisdom saves has no booster id, so saves read low here too.

The Resistance boon's stated level-20 payoff is immunity to all damage while Staring. That is extraordinary and stacks under Lone Wolf's halving; Act III durability is capped at 5 but the real value may be off the ladder. Verify in game before building around it.
Grace: Gift of Will adds the Mesmerist's Charisma modifier plus half their level to the PARTNER's Wisdom saving throw — roughly +15 at 20. Like aura-of-protection it is a pair effect, and unlike aura-of-protection it has no id, so the pair's saves are scored as though it did not exist. This is the single largest under-count in this batch.
Towering Ego is likewise unrepresented. Max spell level unverified.
Reagent: Flash of Genius at Artificer 7 is a reaction adding Intelligence to an ally's ability check or saving throw. It is partner-facing and repeatable and has no booster id, so it contributes nothing to either body's saves.
Elixir effects are random, so the Rescue value is an expected-case reading rather than a guaranteed one.
Rounded Up Spellcaster Level is documented as working only with core-game spellcasters; irrelevant here since Artificer is monoclassed.
Plate: Whether the Arcane Armor weapons use Intelligence for attack and damage is not stated in the class file — Battle Ready is a Battle Smith feature. If they use Strength or Dexterity this chassis is genuinely MAD and the single-target values are a rung high.
Fighter 3 subclass unspecified; scored as Battle Master.
Fighter is taken after Artificer 1, so it grants Light, Medium and Shields only — the heavy armour comes entirely from Arcane Armor.
Bombard: Rescue assumes one cannon is held in Protector mode for its temp-HP field; running two Flamethrowers instead would move that value to roughly 1 and raise AoE.
Flash of Genius at 7 is unrepresented, as on every Artificer.
Steelward: Warding Bond is always prepared at 5, but in a duo it moves damage from one half of the party to the other, so it is scored at rung 1 on its own and contributes nothing above what Deflect Attack and Arcane Jolt already give.
Arcane Jolt uses are Int mod + proficiency bonus per LONG rest, so the outward healing is capped per cycle even though it costs no action; that is why Rescue reaches 5 only in Act III.
Flash of Genius at 7 is unrepresented.
